doc.summary: MCP tool ``lazyown_list_modules``: list modules and scripts in modules/.
doc.description:
Migrated out of the ``lazyown_mcp`` god-file. Demonstrates a tool that
needs a repo-relative resource: it takes the repository root from the
injected :class:`mcp_tools._context.MCPContext` rather than importing the
runtime.

name: TOOL
value: types.Tool(name='lazyown_list_modules', description='List all available LazyOwn modules and scripts in the modules/ directory.', inputSchema={'type': 'object', 'properties': {}})

name: handle
signature: def handle(arguments: dict[str, Any], tool_name: str, ctx: MCPContext) -> list

doc.summary: Return discovered modules as JSON, optionally filtered by type.

params.name: arguments
params.description: May carry a ``type`` key to filter by module type.

params.name: tool_name
params.description: The dispatched tool name, used for the text envelope.

params.name: ctx
params.description: Injected runtime helpers, including the repository root.

returns.description: A one-element ``TextContent`` list holding the module summaries.
